title: Paradox Live Franchise Introduces New Team ILLGATOR for 4th Season
content: The official X/Twitter account for the Paradox Live franchise revealed on Tuesday a new team ILLGATOR for its multimedia project. The franchise 's official YouTube channel began streaming a music video for the group's first song "Daru." (Lazy).

title: 30 Years Later, Classic Fantasy Revival Kicks Off Part 2 With New Trailer – Watch
content: While the Fall 2026 anime season is finally here, one of the biggest Summer 2026 series is still ongoing. Red River is based on a manga written and illustrated by Chie Shinohara, which was serialized in Shogakukan’s Sho-Comi magazine from 1995 to 2002.

title: Major Shonen Jump Anime Expands Cast Ahead of Season 2 Return This Fall
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is almost here, and it’s going to be the most exciting season of the quarter. Fans are all set to welcome the sequels of some of their favorite shows, as almost every major streaming platform has planned an exciting lineup.

title: A/V Post-Production Company Salami Studios Closes
content: Salami Studios worked on multiple anime and animated series over the course of its 30+ years. The recording studio most recently did work on the Cyberpunk 2077: Edgerunners and the upcoming Cyberpunk 2077: Edgerunners 2 anime.

title: 3 Years Later, Naruto’s Anime Revival Is Finally Returning With Global Livestream
content: Naruto has officially confirmed it’s still working on its big TV anime revival, and three years after it was delayed we’re finally going to get a major update on its progress with plans to stream it worldwide.

title: The Vermilion Mask Anime Reveals Singer Yuya Tegoshi as Guest Voice Actor
